key_idea: Count every place where two cubes touch side by side or top to bottom.
steps: All 9 cubes are in one flat wall: 3 in the top row, 2 in the middle row and 4 in the bottom row.
Cubes next to each other in a row: top row 2 drops, middle row 1 drop, bottom row 3 drops. 2 + 1 + 3 = 6.
Cubes on top of each other: 2 between the top row and the middle row, and 2 between the middle row and the bottom row. 2 + 2 = 4.

choice_feedback.A: 8 is one less than the number of cubes. But some cubes touch more than one neighbour, so more drops are needed.
choice_feedback.B: 9 is too few. Count the touches in the rows and between the rows again.
choice_feedback.D: 11 is too many. There are only 6 touches in the rows and 4 between the rows.
choice_feedback.E: 12 is too many. There are only 10 places where two cubes touch.
